verses.text: Ix yalan Dios t'a winhaj Jacob: Elanh t'a tik, ixik kajnajankan t'a Betel. Hata' tza b'ok'e jun altar t'ayin. Hata' in ch'oxnak in b'a t'ayach ayik elnak t'a winh uk'tak aj Esaú, xchi t'a winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Jacob chi' t'a heb' ix yetb'eyum yet' t'a heb' yuninal yet' t'a masanil heb' winh ajun yet'ok: --Ik'ekel masanil juntzanh komon Dios t'a he kal, tze b'ikanel he b'a, tze k'exanel he pichul he masanil.
Koyek elanhchamel t'a Betel. Hata' ol in b'ok'e jun altar yik swik'chaanh sb'i Dios, haton jun ix kolwaj wet'ok ayik ay in och t'a ilk'olal yet' b'ajtak in eq'ui, xchi winh.
Icha chi' ix aj yak'an juntzanh komon Dios yet'nak heb' t'a winhaj Jacob yet' k'een yuchikin heb'. Haxo winh ix b'at mukanem t'a yich jun te' ji ayek' t'a slak'anil Siquem.
Ayik ix el heb' ta', ha Dios ix ak'an xiwk'olal t'a yib'anh masanil juntzanh chonhab' ayek' t'a slak'anil chi', yuj chi' manhxalaj mach ix pechan heb'.
Ix k'och winhaj Jacob chi' yet' masanil heb' anima yet'nak t'a jun lugar skuch Luz, t'a yol yik Canaán. Hanhejtona' jun chonhab' chi' skuchan Betel.
Hata' ix sb'ok'e jun altar winh, El-Betel ix sb'iejkan jun lugar chi' yuj winh, yujto hata' ix sch'ox sb'a Dios t'a winh ayik ix el winh t'a winh yuk'tak.

Hanhejtona' hata' ix cham ix Débora, haton ix ilannak q'uib' ix Rebeca. Ix smukanem ix heb' t'a yich jun te' ji t'a slak'anil Betel chi'. Haxo winhaj Jacob chi' ix sayan sb'i jun lugar chi', Te' Ji yik Kusk'olal, xchi.
Ayik ix jax winh t'a Canaán, spetoj winh t'a Padán-aram, ix sch'oxanxi sb'a Dios t'a winh, ix yalan wach' lolonel t'a yib'anh winh.
Ix yalan icha tik: Ha ach tik Jacob a b'i, palta a tiknaik, manhxo ichokta' ol a b'iej, Israel ol a b'iejkani, xchi t'a winh.

Ayik ix lajwi sk'exan sb'i winh chi', ix yalan t'a winh icha tik: Ha in ton Dios in Syal Wuj Smasanil, manh jantakok ol aj uninal yet' inhtilal. Ha t'ayach ol pitzwok jun nakión, tzijtum chonhab'il ol ajpax elk'ochi. T'a skal inhtilal chi' ay heb' ol och reyal.
Ha lum lum ix wala' to ol wak'kan t'a winhaj Abraham yet' t'a winhaj Isaac, swalpax tiknaik to ol wak'kan t'ayach yet' t'a heb' inhtilal, xchi t'a winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix el Dios b'aj ix lolon yet' winh.

Ix sayan jun niwan k'een winhaj Jacob chi', niwan yaj k'atan k'een, ix sb'oankank'e linhan k'een winh b'aj ix lolon Dios yet'ok. Ix sekank'e akeite yet' wino winh t'a yib'anh k'een, yik syak' winh silab'ok t'a Dios.
Betel ix sb'iejkan jun lugar chi' yuj winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yaktankan jun lugar chi' heb'. Ayto sk'och heb' t'a Efrata, ix alji jun yune' ix Raquel.
Yik wal ayoch ix t'a ilk'olal yuj yab'an syail, haxo ix wetz'wajum ix halani: Manh ach xiwok, toxo ix alji junxo a winak unin, xchi ix.
Palta ayik wanxo scham ix yuj jun unin chi', ix sayankan sb'i ix, Ben-oni ix sb'iejkani. Haxo winhaj Jacob chi' jun, Benjamín ix yak' winh sb'iej.
Hata' ix chamkan ix Raquel chi'. Ix mukchajkan ix t'a sb'eal Efrata, haton jun lugar chi' skuch Belén tiknaik.
Ix sb'oank'e linhan jun kimiento winhaj Jacob t'a yib'anh b'aj ix mukchaj sniwanil ix chi', haton jun chi' sch'oxankan b'ajtil mukan ix.
Ix b'atnhej winhaj Israel chi', ix sb'oan skampamento winh t'a yichanhb'at Torre yik Edar.

Yakb'an kajan ek' heb' t'a jun lugar chi', haxo winhaj Rubén, yuninal winhaj Israel chi' ix way winh yet' ix Bilha, schab'il yetb'eyum winh smam chi'. Ix yab' winhaj Israel chi' tas ix sk'ulej winh yunin chi'. Lajchawanh heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jacob chi':
Ha heb' winh yuninal winh yet' ix Lea: Haton winhaj Rubén, winh b'ab'el unin, winhaj Simeón, winhaj Leví, winhaj Judá, winhaj Isacar yet' winhaj Zabulón.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winh yet' ix Raquel: Haton winhaj José yet' winhaj Benjamín.
Haxo heb' yuninal winh yet' ix Bilha, ix skriada ix Raquel: Haton winhaj Dan yet' winhaj Neftalí.
Haxo pax heb' yuninal winh yet' ix Zilpa, ix skriada ix Lea: Haton winhaj Gad yet' winhaj Aser. Haton heb' tik yuninal winhaj Jacob ix alji t'a Padán-aram.
Ix b'at winhaj Jacob yil winh smam, haton winhaj Isaac, kajan t'a lum Mamre, t'a chonhab' Arba, Hebrón pax sb'i. Hata' ek'nak winhaj Abraham yet' winhaj Isaac chi'.
180 ab'il sk'inal winhaj Isaac chi' ayik ix cham winh.
Te ichamxo winh, haxo winhaj Esaú yet' winhaj Jacob, haton heb' winh yuninal winh, a heb' winh ix mukankan winh.
